name: Henshin ☆ a la Maid
original_name: へんしん☆ア・ラ・メイド
source:
Shinjo Akemi is a director of Shinjo Institute. A mysterious creature arrives from space to rule the Earth. It aims to deprive humanity of its best weapon - battle suit "a la Maid". For that it's going take away three maid stones.
Akemi chooses three girls from all over the world to fight the impostor in battle suits imbued with pure maid feelings.
Can these three person protect the Earth?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新条朱美是新条研究所的所长。某天，企图统治地球的神秘宇宙生物自外太空降临，企图夺走人类最强的王牌兵器——战斗服“女仆风尚”，并为此盯上了三颗核心宝石“女仆之石”。
朱美从世界各地甄选出三名少女，让她们身披灌注了纯粹女仆之心的战斗服迎战外星侵略者。
这三名少女究竟能否守护地球的和平？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
